description: This PHP source file defines the ElasticLoadBalancingClient class in the Aws\ElasticLoadBalancing namespace, which is used to interact with the AWS Elastic Load Balancing service. It contains method annotations for various operations related to load balancer management, such as creating load balancers, configuring health checks, and managing load balancer policies.
